topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: I really wanted to say yes when my neighbor, Jenny, asked if she could use a corner of my yard for her garden. It's a small space that doesn't get much use, and I could see the excitement in her eyes as she talked about her plans for tomatoes and basil. The truth is, I do worry a little about the maintenance and what it might mean to our property, but I also recall how she helped me when my car wouldn't start last winter. I told her I’d need some time to think about it, which felt like a small lie, hoping she wouldn’t read too much into my hesitation. I just need to figure out what’s the right thing to do.
